payload.authorization: User explicitly requests one TRAIN-only impossible-gain exclusion and fixed-recipe posthoc refit against unchanged 13 TEST units.
payload.evaluation: All fixed models and all 40 nulls. Joint qualification, updates, old accuracy, new guard, utility, class Brier and accuracy, per-budget recovery Brier and utility MSE/MAE. Per-source, pooled and equal-source; no policy selection, significance tests, intent bootstrap, or permutation redraws.

fixed_recipe.class_rule: Minimum budget is the smallest tested budget passing unchanged accuracy/gain/guard gates; never if none. Do not assume monotonic recovery. Normalize clipped one-hot ridge scores for multiclass Brier; these are forecasts to test, not assumed calibrated probabilities.

label_permutations.rule: Seal indices using all eligible fresh TRAIN units at the fresh cohort gate before repair. Fit 40 tuned-feature nulls using TRAIN-label permutations only, shared across all outcome targets. Report actual changed labels and active/inert draw counts by scheme for the minimum class, every one-hot class, per-budget binary recovery and utility. Retain inert scalar draws; no redraw.

fixed_recipe.policy_rule: Choose the most probable minimum class, breaking ties toward the smaller numeric budget; never maps to no action. Save choices before TEST repair. The main policy report pairs qualification fraction, updates and utility for each source, pooled and equal-source. Compare every policy with always-2, always-16 and TRAIN-majority (constant_train); retain fixed 4/8/no-action too. Any descriptive savings claim requires positive baseline qualification and no qualification loss on each heldout source. Class accuracy alone is not a policy win. Exhaustive paired-grid evaluation estimates policy behavior, not actual savings in study total updates.
fixed_recipe.predictor: Per-scalar ridge with fixed alpha 10 and TRAIN-only centering/scaling, equal intent weights. Fit 5 one-hot minimum classes (2/4/8/16/never), and per-budget recovery and continuous utility. No hyperparameter or feature selection from TEST.

payload.interpretation: A sensitivity benefit would require new prospective data before a prediction benefit claim. Thirteen TEST intents comprise two source clusters; those sources and outcomes were already observed.
payload.name: one-posthoc-TRAIN-impossible-gain-sensitivity
payload.posthoc_gate_boundary: Report the unchanged prospective class-support gate even when failed. This user-authorized diagnostic uses its frozen ridge, targets, scalers and class rule without the prospective dispatch gate. No new TEST training or prospective authorization follows.

primary_rule.arithmetic: Exact integer correct/total fractions; strict inequality. Equality remains eligible.
primary_rule.exclude: 1 - actual pre-repair repair-evaluation-panel accuracy < required gain

payload.scope: Posthoc sensitivity after original TEST outcomes were observed. Not prospective, independently held-out replication, or a revised original study.
payload.secondary_eligibility: Report actual acquired-panel floor, actual after maximum, actual before-after drop. Initial actual-panel scores are absent, so actual acquisition gain is unknown. These diagnostics add no exclusions.
